\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\sffamily]
    \begin{axis}[
        xmin=0, xmax=3.0,
        ymin=-8, ymax=12,
        xtick={0,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5,3.0},
        xticklabels={0,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5,},
        ytick={-5,0,5,10},
        xlabel={time / s},
        ylabel={velocity / m/s},
        axis x line=center,
        axis y line=center,
        xlabel style={right},
        ylabel style={above},
        grid=both,
        grid style={line, thin, gray!30},
        major grid style={line, thick, gray!50},
        width=12cm, height=8cm,
        every axis x label/.style={at={(current axis.right of origin)},anchor=west},
        every axis y label/.style={at={(current axis.above origin)},anchor=south},
    ]

        % Line from origin to X(1.0, 10)
        \addplot[thick, domain=0:1.0] {10*x};

        % Dashed line from X(1.0, 10) to Y(1.2, -6)
        % Equation of line: y - 10 = (( -6 - 10 ) / ( 1.2 - 1.0 )) * (x - 1.0)
        % y - 10 = (-16 / 0.2) * (x - 1.0) = -80*(x - 1.0) = -80x + 80
        % y = -80x + 90
        \addplot[thick, dashed, domain=1.0:1.2] {-80*x + 90};

        % Line from Y(1.2, -6) to Z(1.8, 0)
        % Equation of line: y - (-6) = ((0 - (-6)) / (1.8 - 1.2)) * (x - 1.2)
        % y + 6 = (6 / 0.6) * (x - 1.2) = 10*(x - 1.2) = 10x - 12
        % y = 10x - 18
        \addplot[thick, domain=1.2:1.8] {10*x - 18};

        % Labels for points X, Y, Z
        \node[above right] at (axis cs:1.0, 10) {X};
        \node[below left] at (axis cs:1.2, -6) {Y};
        \node[above right] at (axis cs:1.8, 0) {Z};

        % Coordinate markers / dots for clarity at key points
        \fill (axis cs:1.0, 10) circle (1.5pt);
        \fill (axis cs:1.2, -6) circle (1.5pt);
        \fill (axis cs:1.8, 0) circle (1.5pt);

    end{axis}

    % Caption below the figure
    \node at (6.2,-4.7) {Fig. 1.1};

\end{tikzpicture}
